title: Coinbase Launches ChatGPT Plugin for Trading Bitcoin, Stocks, and Derivatives
content: Bitcoin Magazine Coinbase Launches ChatGPT Plugin for Trading Bitcoin, Stocks, and Derivatives Coinbase launched an official ChatGPT plugin Tuesday that lets users connect an account and trade bitcoin, other crypto, stocks and derivatives in the chat, approving every order. The official plugin is currently available to U.S. users. This post Coinbase Launches ChatGPT Plugin for Trading Bitcoin, Stocks, and Derivatives first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .

title: Trezor Shipping Partner Breach Exposes 27,000 Orders as Customers Report Scam Calls
content: Bitcoin Magazine Trezor Shipping Partner Breach Exposes 27,000 Orders as Customers Report Scam Calls A breach at shipping partner Skladon exposed names, addresses, emails, phone numbers and purchase details for about 27,000 Trezor orders, the company said, and some customers have already reported scam calls. Wallet backups were not involved. This post Trezor Shipping Partner Breach Exposes 27,000 Orders as Customers Report Scam Calls first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .

title: Wells Fargo More Than Doubles Its Bitcoin ETF Stake to $2.35 Billion
content: Bitcoin Magazine Wells Fargo More Than Doubles Its Bitcoin ETF Stake to $2.35 Billion Wells Fargo's third-quarter 13F shows 49.6 million IBIT shares worth $2.35 billion at Sept. 30, up from 24.4 million, while its Strategy stake fell about 33% to 1.34 million shares. This post Wells Fargo More Than Doubles Its Bitcoin ETF Stake to $2.35 Billion first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .

title: Goldman Sachs More Than Doubles Its Bitcoin ETF Holdings to $1.28 Billion
content: Bitcoin Magazine Goldman Sachs More Than Doubles Its Bitcoin ETF Holdings to $1.28 Billion Goldman Sachs' third-quarter 13F shows $1.28 billion in spot bitcoin ETFs at Sept. 30, up from about $580 million, led by a 52-fold jump in Fidelity's fund, while its Strategy stake fell about 52%. This post Goldman Sachs More Than Doubles Its Bitcoin ETF Holdings to $1.28 Billion first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .

title: Bitcoin Policy Institute Renames to Finney Foundation for Open Technology
content: Bitcoin Magazine Bitcoin Policy Institute Renames to Finney Foundation for Open Technology The Bitcoin Policy Institute said Tuesday it is now the Finney Foundation for Open Technology, a parent organization whose brief spans open-source AI, digital cash and encrypted messaging, with bitcoin remaining a primary focus. This post Bitcoin Policy Institute Renames to Finney Foundation for Open Technology first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .
